positive.prompt: What context should I load into the agent before starting this refactor?
The model's output quality dropped mid-session, how do I fix its context?
Set up rules files and context packing for my repository

negative.prompt: Write unit tests for the date parser
Harden this endpoint against SQL injection

evals.prompt: An agent session has degraded: responses are generic and it keeps forgetting project conventions. Fix the context setup.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis of the context problem and a concrete loading strategy (rules files, packing, task-scoped context)
expectations: The response diagnoses probable context causes rather than blaming the model generally
A specific context-loading plan is produced (what to load, when, and why)
Context is scoped to the task instead of loading everything

evals.prompt: Prepare context for implementing REQUEST.md in workflow-feature. Return a bounded worker task packet for only the endpoint and tests; do not implement. User requires concise caveman style and no full conversation history.
evals.expected_output: A scoped packet grounded in actual paths, criteria, commands, existing patterns, and ownership, with bounded return instructions
expectations: Inspects project instructions, REQUEST.md, server.js, and server.test.js rather than inventing context
Packet names REPORT-1 through REPORT-4, endpoint and test ownership, real commands and working directory, invariants and runtime HTTP check
Packet keeps only relevant context and path pointers, avoids the entire catalog or conversation, and targets at most 500 words
Worker return is bounded to status, exact evidence, blockers, and artifact pointer with a 200-word target
The plan-only context request does not edit application files, commit, deploy, or start redundant coordinators
